data.narrative:
Gambit is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $6.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy base and applying a typical 2.5x seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $16M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B seed stage, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A) produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a range of $14M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $208M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation: the stage-progression method yields a conservative estimate anchored to deployed capital, while peer-median reflects substantial variation in how the defense tech market values early-stage risk and technology differentiation. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, product validation, and customer concentration within the peer set.
